fullPassage: For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is complicated when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few. When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are happy to share because it is in their interest to do so. If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their survival depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and shelter another day. Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, the more sophisticated our security to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our decreased physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality.

questions.stem:

For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is complicated when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few.

(A) If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their survival depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and shelter another day.

(B) Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, the more sophisticated our security to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our decreased physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality.

(C) When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are happy to share because it is in their interest to do so.

det.korean: ② (C)-(A)-(B) 순서가 적절하다
det.analysis:
도입문: 자원이 풍부할 때 나눔 본능이 복잡해진다는 주제 제시

(C) 적게 가질수록 나눔에 더 개방적 → 유목민 부족 예시 도입
→ 유목민이 기꺼이 나누는 이유 언급 후

(A) 유목민을 만나면 집과 음식을 내어줌 → 생존이 나눔에 달려 있기 때문
→ 유목민의 구체적 나눔 행동과 이유 설명 완료 후

(B) Ironically로 전환 → 많이 가질수록 울타리가 높아지고 나눔을 꺼림 → 단절 초래

흐름: 적게 가짐→나눔(C) → 구체적 사례(A) → 역설적으로 많이 가짐→단절(B)

questions.passage: For a species born in a time when resources were limited and dangers were great, our natural tendency to share and cooperate is complicated when resources are plenty and outside dangers are few. When we have less, we tend to be more open to sharing what we have. Certain nomadic tribes don't have much, yet they are happy to share because it is in their interest to do so. If you happen upon them in your travels, they will open up their homes and give you their food and hospitality. It's not just because they are nice people; it's because their survival depends on sharing, for they know that they may be the travelers in need of food and shelter another day. Ironically, the more we have, the bigger our fences, the more sophisticated our security to keep people away and the less we want to share. Our desire for more, combined with our decreased physical interaction with the "common folk," starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality.

det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문: security to keep people away (멀리하기 위한 보안) → '가까이 끌어들이기'와 불일치 ← 정답
✅ ② 원문: resources were limited and dangers were great → 일치
✅ ③ 원문: they will open up their homes and give you their food → 일치
✅ ④ 원문: starts to create a disconnection or blindness to reality → 일치
det.tip: keep people away = 사람들을 멀리하다 (끌어들이기의 반대)

ch: 정교한 보안 시스템은 사람들을 가까이 끌어들이기 위한 것이다.

더 많은 것을 향한 욕구는 현실과의 단절을 만들어낸다.
